start.title: Whispers Among Ruins
start.text: Night drapes the shattered citadel of Eldoria. In the hush, a silver moth dances over broken stone—and a voice, like wind through glass, calls your name. You feel the weight of a forgotten oath stir within you.

choices.text: Ignore it and search the ruins for supplies.

scavenge.title: Echoes in the Dust
scavenge.text: You sift through toppled columns and moss-wet bricks. Your fingers close on a rusted key and a faded emblem of the Dawn Guild.

choices.text: Pocket the finds and move on.

crossroads.title: Paths of the Vale
crossroads.text: At the vale's heart three paths divide: lanterns glow in a distant village, the Verdantwood breathes with hidden life, and a star-torn tower scratches the sky.

village.title: Ash and Embers
village.text: Smoke laces the streets. A healer kneels by the wounded. The villagers speak of a shadow that steals warmth from the wells.

choices.text: Help the healer (lose time, gain respect).
Rally the villagers to defend the wells.

v_heal.title: Warm Hands, Warmer Names
v_heal.text: You bind wounds and share the poultice. Names become smiles. Someone presses a charm into your palm: 'May the Dawn guide you.'

v_search.title: Quiet Doors, Quieter Guilt
v_search.text: You find a cache of silver and a ledger naming tithe-givers. The healer watches, saying nothing.

choices.text: Keep the silver and move on.

v_rally.title: Circles of Fire
v_rally.text: With words and will, you set watchfires and hearts alight. The wells steam, unafraid of night.

choices.text: Accept their oath to the Dawn Guild.

forest.title: Shadebound Pact
forest.text: Moonlight webs the branches. A masked rogue steps from the ferns, offering a sigil that thrums like a heartbeat.

choices.text: Refuse and duel to first blood.
Parley: trade the Dawn Emblem for safe passage.

f_accept.title: Cold Ink, Warm Whisper
f_accept.text: The sigil burns cold into your palm. The rogue whispers: 'When the tower calls, choose the shadowed door.'

f_duel.title: Edge of Leaves
f_duel.text: Steel sings; sap spatters. You disarm the rogue, who vanishes with a laugh. The forest watches, unimpressed.

choices.text: Catch your breath and head to the tower.

f_trade.title: Emblem for Silence
f_trade.text: You trade symbol for silence. The rogue marks a hidden stair in the tower: 'Sunlight reveals what shadow hides.'

tower.title: Star-Torn Spire
tower.text: The tower's gates yawn. Inside, three doors shiver with light: left, a warm gold; middle, a cold violet; right, a patient gray stair curling upward.

choices.text: Enter the violet door (requires Shadow Sigil).
Take the gray stair (easier with Dawn Charm or hint).

door_gold.title: Shard of the Sun
door_gold.text: A hall of mirrors and morning. At its end rests a shard that hums with kindness. You reach out...

door_violet.title: Thorn of Night
door_violet.text: Violet fire knits around a black thorn. Your sigil answers, drinking the dark.

stair_gray.title: Hidden Helix
stair_gray.text: Dust whispers as you climb the hidden stair. A mural shows dawn and dusk entwined—neither winning, both needed.

summit.title: Crown of Wind
summit.text: At the spire's crown the silver moth returns, unfolding into a figure of light and shadow. 'Eldoria does not need a ruler,' it says. 'It needs a choice.'

choices.text: Fuse the Sun Shard and Dawn Oath (Guardian Ending)
Wield the Night Thorn with the Shadow Sigil (Pact Ending)
Refuse both powers—walk the middle way (Wanderer Ending)

end_guardian.title: Guardian of Eldoria
end_guardian.text: Light braids with oath. Wells warm, fields green, and names are remembered. You become a keeper, not a king. (Good Ending)

end_pact.title: A Shadow's Promise
end_pact.text: Dusk crowns the citadel. You bind the dark to a purpose: to watch the watchmen, to question the light. Eldoria exhales—uneasy, alive. (Antihero Ending)

end_wanderer.title: The Road Between
end_wanderer.text: You leave the crown to the wind. In taverns and thresholds your name becomes a story, and the story a lantern others carry. (Neutral Ending)
